design_note: Fixed-location donor-sensitivity follow-up to the completed 198-trial discovery scan. Call 0/layer 9/node vectors is the selected candidate; pair vectors are a component comparison. Use every remaining recorded reference seed (45-49, 51), none used as donors to select this location. Same recipient seed 50: this is NOT independent-recipient or cross-molecule validation. Seven baselines + two shams + twelve targeted patches + twelve matched random controls = 33 rollouts. Report all donors and both components, including failures; do not move the location or change the endpoint to obtain a rescue. Future within-layer localization depends on these results.
